answer: Players of Hades II most frequently complain about bugs and gameplay issues. According to the sentiment analysis [T1], bugs are mentioned in 30 reviews (3.2% of all reviews), with 49.42% of these mentions being negative, and 1.58% classified as complaints. Gameplay issues are mentioned in 246 reviews (21.28% of all reviews), with 16.58% of these mentions being negative and 3.53% classified as complaints. The most common complaints relate to performance issues, character designs, and weapon mechanics [1].
